title: Bentong Monsoon Marathon 2026 Review: A Rain-Season Full Marathon in Janda Baik
seo_title: Bentong Monsoon Marathon 2026 Review | Pahang Malaysia Race
meta_description: The Bentong Monsoon Marathon 2026: November 28 in Janda Baik, Bentong, Pahang. Full and half marathon with registration open — a monsoon-season hill-country race reviewed.
dek: Set for 28 November 2026 in Janda Baik, Bentong — a hill-country retreat near Kuala Lumpur — this monsoon-season marathon offers full and half distances with registration open. A cool-air escape race just outside the capital.
verdict: The Bentong Monsoon Marathon leans into its name: a November race in Janda Baik, a hill-country village in the Titiwangsa Range roughly an hour from KL, where the monsoon brings cool temperatures and misty mornings. Two distances (42K, 21K) with registration open. The venue — Janda Baik at roughly 600m elevation — means cooler conditions than KL's tropical heat, but also more hills. A distinctive Malaysian marathon for runners who prefer elevation and cool air over flat city tarmac.

sections.heading: Janda Baik: KL's Hill-Country Escape
paragraphs: Janda Baik sits at roughly 600m in the Titiwangsa Range, offering substantially cooler temperatures than Kuala Lumpur. [1] The monsoon-season setting means misty mornings and lush green surroundings — a fundamentally different marathon experience from a KL city race. Expect hills; this is not a PB course.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a cool-air, hill-country marathon near KL with open registration, the Bentong Monsoon Marathon delivers. The 2026 edition is set for 28 November in Janda Baik, Bentong, Pahang. [1]

faqs.question: When is the Bentong Monsoon Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: 28 November 2026 in Janda Baik, Bentong, Pahang, Malaysia. It offers 42.2K and 21.1K. Registration is currently open. Mark it on your calendar if you're planning your racing year around it. [1]

faqs.question: Is registration open?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration is open. It's held at Janda Baik, Bentong, Pahang. It offers 42.2K and 21.1K. Sign-up typically runs through the organiser's official registration channel. Entry numbers can be capped, so earlier sign-up is generally safer. [1]
